preconditions: Content locale catalog is owned by Content and exposed through the admin contract with a CAS revision.
The service under test uses an in-core fake repository with no external PostgreSQL or S3 dependency.
scenarios.input: Replace locale config with non-canonical tags, a duplicate after canonicalization, a missing default and then a valid catalog; repeat the valid write with the next expected revision.
scenarios.action: Call ReplaceLocaleConfig and GetLocaleConfig through the Content application service.
scenarios.expected_result: Locales are canonicalized and ordered, duplicates and an absent default are rejected, and a valid CAS write advances the catalog revision.
scenarios.expected_state: The stored catalog is the canonical revision returned by the successful write; invalid writes leave it unchanged.

preconditions: A ready trusted ContentModelProjection and PagePlacementProjection are supplied by the caller.
Draft mutations use expected_revision, expected_selection_revision and an Idempotency-Key.
scenarios.input: Save a draft with client-keyed records, replay the same idempotency key, reuse it with a changed payload and write with a stale revision.
scenarios.action: Call SaveWorkspaceDraft on the Content application service and compare the replies and revisions.
scenarios.expected_result: Server-generated record/translation IDs are replayed, the same key with a different payload conflicts, and stale CAS is rejected without partial application.
scenarios.expected_state: Exactly one successful draft mutation advances the workspace revision; the idempotent replay does not advance it again.

preconditions: A workspace has a valid saved draft for one locale and page snapshot.
Publication history is append-only and restore creates a new draft.
scenarios.input: Publish draft A, publish changed draft B, list history, restore A and read published content; repeat the publish and restore keys.
scenarios.action: Call PublishWorkspace, ListHistory, RestoreHistory and ReadPublishedContent on the Content application service.
scenarios.expected_result: Both publications are immutable history entries, idempotent retries replay their receipts, restore changes only the draft, and public content remains revision B until published again.
scenarios.expected_state: History contains both publications in order; the published pointer still identifies B after restore.

preconditions: Source and target page snapshots have ready/provisioning trusted projections.
System-wide records and publication history are shared; only page-scoped selections may be copied or reset.
scenarios.input: Fork a source snapshot with draft-only records and ordered selections, replay the copy receipt, reuse its key with another policy and fork with a stale source revision.
scenarios.action: Call CopySnapshotContent through the Content application service and inspect the target workspace, publication and source history.
scenarios.expected_result: The copy is idempotent by key and policy, stale source revision conflicts before mutation, target page selections are copied or reset, and shared publication history is unchanged.
scenarios.expected_state: The target receives only page-scoped selection state; no source records, drafts or history are duplicated.

preconditions: A disposable PostgreSQL/S3 stack and a live Router/Admin API built from this checkout are available.
Separate disposable admin and public base URLs and a bounded timeout are supplied through environment variables.
scenarios.input: Publish one locale through the real Admin API, observe per-route/per-locale fan-out outcomes, then request published content and media references through the configured public route.
scenarios.action: Run the tagged browser/HTTP e2e flow with CONTENT_TEST_DISPOSABLE=1 and the declared base URLs.
scenarios.expected_result: Only published records and selections for the requested locale are projected; each route/locale CAS result is reported independently; no draft content or private file bytes leak.
scenarios.expected_state: Without a disposable isolated stack the scenario is not executed and is never reported as pass.
scenarios.blocker: Disposable Content environment not provided: require CONTENT_TEST_DISPOSABLE=1, CONTENT_TEST_ADMIN_BASE_URL, CONTENT_TEST_PUBLIC_BASE_URL and CONTENT_TEST_TIMEOUT. No live working API is used.
